title: South polar layered terrain (target area)

height.license: USGS Astrogeology product; HRSC data ESA/DLR/FU Berlin (CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO), MOLA public domain

color.product: THEMIS Day IR global mosaic v12 (100 m)

note: Approximate target point only: the two probes were never found, so their true impact spots are unknown. No HiRISE or CTX terrain model covers this spot, so heights come from the ~200 m HRSC-MOLA blend, smoothly upsampled; small rocks and craters are missing. Image is the 100 m THEMIS daytime infrared mosaic (brightness shows temperature, not colour), upsampled.
